prompt: In many countries, primary and secondary schools close for two months or more in the summer holidays. What is the value of long school holidays? What are the arguments in favour of shorter school holidays?
essay:
Nowadays, in many countries, primary and secondary schools are closing between two months and sometimes more during the summer periods. This essay will discuss  the importance  of long holidays, as well as many points about the benefits of having a shorter break.

A long break for students is essential for their lifestyle, because it gives them time to rest, do activities,  travel, but also to work to gain experience in real life and discover the real world, in addition to what they learn at school. For example, in Europe, many schools offer this time to the pupils to let them have the opportunity to travel and discover other cultures, to do an internship, or an exchange program. It is very important to give them a space between their life and school to let them discover new hobbies, passions,and adifferent vision of the world.

But on the other hand, short holidays can be efficient for some people, because a too long period can be hard for some because it leads to difficulties getting back to the routine, to readapt themselves.For instance, in France, holidays are frequent, every two months. The government wants to reduce it, because students are not performing well after a long time without studying, reading , etc. So, they want to limit the frequency of breaks to lead to a better way of learning

To conclude, most schools take into account the importance of giving a long break to their students for their well-being. But  some points value the short breaks' benefits.
